blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine sepak takraw team settled for a historic silver medal in women’s doubles of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after being handed a 15-8, 15-4 defeat by Vietnam in Tuesday’s final. Team captain Abegail Sinogbuhan, Jean Marie Sucalit and substitute Nelly Jay Saron were outmatched by the Vietnamese side that dominated the gold-medal match held at Mizuho Park Gymnasium.
